LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: ModelLess: A Serverless System for Multi-Tier LLM Inference on Shared GPUs 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Ding Shi, Wei Wu, Jiayuan Chen, Chenghu Yang 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Memory.WorkingMemory 🕒 发布时间： 2026-11-24 13:56:15 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32634 🔗 触发的灵感来源： Held While Waiting: What LLM Agent Sessions Reserve on Serverless and Agent Runtimes, Aggron: Aggressive Compression of Agentic KV Caches during Head-of-Line Stalls in the Request Queue 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去关注单一内存组件（如 KV 缓存）的压缩方法不同，本文关注无服务器架构下多层级 GPU 共享的完整生命周期管理，涵盖权重、执行状态和请求队列。 🧠 核心术语库 [[ModelLess]] [[Serverless]] [[Preemption]] [[Weight-Copy Path]] [[Execution State]] [[Admission Control]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 论文针对无服务器架构中 LLM 推理服务在业务间隙 GPU 资源闲置的问题，提出 ModelLess 系统。核心思想是通过允许服务实例在空闲时缩容至零并共享 GPU，利用闲置资源服务低优先级任务，同时精细管理模型的权重、执行状态和 KV 缓存，以平衡资源利用率与服务可用性。 🔬 Method 系统通过入口、调度器和节点代理等组件 enforcing 一个抢占协议。对于 Flex 层级，采用暂停/恢复机制处理正在进行的请求；对于 RL rollout，使用权重拷贝路径；在内存释放前先关闭准入控制，并确保请求持久化重排队。这种设计确保了在抢占或缩容时，关键状态得以保留。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review ModelLess 有效地利用了 GPU 的闲置时间，通过精细的状态管理机制（如权重拷贝和请求持久化）实现了多层级服务共享，显著提升了系统吞吐量，尽管实现复杂度较高。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: RePrism: Joint Request and Representation Scheduling for LLM Agent Serving 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Xijiang Shen, Aoli Zhu, Yanbo Tan, Xiyuan Hu, Huailiang Tan 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Skill.Representation 🕒 发布时间： 2026-11-24 13:02:57 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32545 🔗 触发的灵感来源： Contexture: Runtime Context Eviction for High-Throughput Agent Serving, Aggron: Aggressive Compression of Agentic KV Caches during Head-of-Line Stalls in the Request Queue 🔄 深度差量对比： 不同于 Aggron 和 Contexture 侧重于 KV 缓存的压缩与驱逐，RePrism 专注于请求与表示形式的联合调度，通过优化选择策略而非被动管理内存来提升效率。 🧠 核心术语库 [[RePrism]] [[Joint Scheduling]] [[Representation Selection]] [[LoRA Adapter]] [[Session Completion Time]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 现有 LLM Agent 服务系统多局限于请求排序或固定缓存方案，未能充分利用 prompt 的多种表示形式。RePrism 的核心思想是联合调度就绪请求与其 prompt 的多种表示形式，通过评估即时与未来价值来优化系统吞吐量并缩短会话完成时间。 🔬 Method RePrism 包含调度器和资源管理器。调度器基于工作流依赖关系，对请求与其可用表示对进行联合评分；资源管理器在 LoRA 适配器和 KV 缓存状态间动态分配 GPU 内存，并根据内存压力管理其准入与驱逐策略。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review RePrism 通过联合优化请求与表示选择，显著提升了系统吞吐量并大幅缩短了会话完成时间，展现了在复杂工作流服务中的优越性。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: 有效地填补了 RSI 评估的空白，突显了跨领域转移经验的潜力，尽管存在个体任务退化。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: RecurSciBench: Benchmarking Recursive Self-Improvement in Data-Driven Scientific Research 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Wenxi Xu, Chuan Qin, Zihan Wang, Zixing Chen, Le Zhang, Jingbo Zhou, Hao Wang, Yuanchun Zhou, Hengshu Zhu 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Experience.Reflection 🕒 发布时间： 2026-11-24 12:38:22 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32508 🔗 触发的灵感来源： Optimistic Online Learning for Coding Agents with Aggregate Feedback, AutoSECO: Automated Skill Evolution for Cross-Problem Combinatorial Optimization with General-Purpose LLM Agents, MetaSkill: Reusable Problem-Solving Methods for Adaptive Skill Orchestration in LLM Agents, Neural Agent Compiler: Learning to Schedule Soft Dependencies, STRIDE: Strategy-to-Tactics Retrieval-Guided Skill Disclosure and Evolution for Agentic Reinforcement Learning 🔄 深度差量对比： 与以往笔记中关注技能库管理或记忆优化的论文不同，本文专注于为递归自我改进建立可执行的基准和评估框架。 🧠 核心术语库 [[Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI)]] [[RecurSciBench]] [[RecurSciPipe]] [[Scientific Verification]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 现有 LLM 代理在数据驱动科学研究中的递归自我改进（RSI）评估缺乏可执行且科学上可验证的基准。RecurSciBench 引入了一个可扩展的基准测试，通过自动构建建模和分析任务，提供基于执行的验证和科学有效性检查，以评估 RSI 的跨任务转移。 🔬 Method RecurSciBench 采用 RecurSciPipe 框架，从原始数据集自动构建科学建模和分析任务，确保基于执行的验证和科学有效性检查。该基准测试覆盖四个科学领域、多种数据模态和不同的科学目标。它评估了四个 RSI 系统，通过比较它们在源任务进化后的初始和进化状态，来测试同类型、跨类型和跨领域的转移。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review 有效地填补了 RSI 评估的空白，突显了跨领域转移经验的潜力，尽管存在个体任务退化。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.title: XMind: Thinking Twice via Cross-Memory Reasoning for LLM-Based Autonomous Driving
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.short_review: 通过反事实推演生成可靠证据并构建风险胶囊，显著提升了智能体在未知场景下的决策成功率，但应用场景局限于自动驾驶领域。
LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: XMind: Thinking Twice via Cross-Memory Reasoning for LLM-Based Autonomous Driving 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Zuyi Guo, Xianjie Dai, Lei Yang, Xiaocong Zhao, Jingguang Li, Kitae Jang, Heye Huang 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Memory.WorkingMemory 🕒 发布时间： 2026-11-24 08:55:02 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32209 🔗 触发的灵感来源： Optimistic Online Learning for Coding Agents with Aggregate Feedback, EvoViM: Recursively Self-Evolving Visual Agents for Exploration with Deferred Queries, Neural Agent Compiler: Learning to Schedule Soft Dependencies, AstronautBench: Measuring Agent Self-Improvement Across Episodes Through Knowledge, Evidence, and Progress 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过往笔记中侧重记忆存储、压缩或技能管理的论文不同，XMind 聚焦于记忆检索与工作记忆的融合，旨在解决特定高风险场景下的决策鲁棒性问题。 🧠 核心术语库 [[Cross-Memory Reasoning]] [[Risk Capsules]] [[Counterfactual Rollouts]] [[Working Memory]] [[Episodic Memory]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 现有 LLM 驾驶智能体在交通环境变化时，难以将过去的经验有效迁移到新场景，且现有记忆仅记录结果缺乏证据。核心思想是引入“跨记忆推理”机制，通过整合当前上下文的 Working Memory 和包含风险证据的 Episodic Memory，使智能体在初步决策后进行二次验证与修正。 🔬 Method 该框架采用无训练设计，利用 Counterfactual Rollouts 在扰动条件下验证替代行动，将验证结果存储为结构化的 Risk Capsules。在推理时，智能体先基于当前状态决策，再检索历史胶囊进行冲突检查。若冲突，则依据胶囊证据做出修正决策。检索过程结合了空间风险模式匹配和场景语义匹配。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review 通过反事实推演生成可靠证据并构建风险胶囊，显著提升了智能体在未知场景下的决策成功率，但应用场景局限于自动驾驶领域。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: SCOPE: Evaluating and Enhancing Permission Explanation Transparency in Mobile Apps 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Liu Wang, Tianshu Zhou, Haoyu Wang, Xiyuan Liu, Yi Wang 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Tool.Understanding 🕒 发布时间： 2026-11-24 07:39:44 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32122 🔗 触发的灵感来源： ArguShield: Enforcing Minimum-Necessary Disclosure in Tool-Calling LLM Agents, Useful but Unwieldy: How Software Engineers Perceive the Design of Chain-of-Thought Explanations in Coding Agents, SCARVA: Interpretable Agentic Reasoning in Software Supply-Chain Analysis 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中研究代理工具执行隐私保护或推理可解释性不同，本文聚焦移动应用权限说明的透明度提升。 🧠 核心术语库 [[Permission Explanation]] [[Transparency]] [[Multi-agent Framework]] [[LLM-based Extraction]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 移动应用权限说明缺乏系统性评估，导致用户隐私透明度不足。该研究通过实证分析600款主流应用，发现权限说明存在解释缺失、语言模糊及第三方SDK数据访问未披露等问题，提出SCOPE框架以增强权限说明透明度。 🔬 Method SCOPE框架采用四代理协同工作：基于LLM的多模态说明提取、基于few-shot学习的语言分析、动态API目的推断和自适应报告生成，通过自动化评估和优化权限说明。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review SCOPE有效提升了权限说明的准确性和用户接受度，但未考虑不同应用场景下的个性化说明需求。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: ExpGuard: Guarding Long-Horizon LLM Agents against Corrupted Experience 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Yuzhou Chen, Licheng Pan, Zhixuan Chu, Yunsheng Lu, Yichen Sun, Han Zheng, Yan Wang, Bingyu Zhu, Haiwen Hong, Longtao Huang, Kui Ren 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Memory.ExternalMemory 🕒 发布时间： 2026-11-24 07:09:54 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32085 🔗 触发的灵感来源： Carried-Over and Agent-Native Threats in the Supply Chain of LLM Agent Skills, EvoViM: Recursively Self-Evolving Visual Agents for Exploration with Deferred Queries, EvoTER: Evolving Embodied Agents via Tool-Use Experience and Reflection 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中的研究不同，ExpGuard 专注于长时程 LLM 代理中经验污染的风险评估和修复，而非单一技能或记忆优化。 🧠 核心术语库 [[ExpGuard]] [[Experience Risk Assessment]] [[Online Repair]] [[Task-Conditioned Heterogeneous Graph]] [[Counterfactual Replay]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 长时程 LLM 代理通过提炼过去轨迹为可重用经验，但源轨迹中的误导性或对抗性指导可能污染这些经验，导致有害指令跨任务传播并影响未来行为。评估可能被污染的经验风险面临三大挑战：建模经验重用前的来源和执行依赖关系、从轨迹结果中学习任务条件风险、以及在线推理时修复风险经验。ExpGuard 通过检索触发的经验风险评估和在线修复框架解决这些问题。 🔬 Method ExpGuard 首先在任务条件下将经验语义与来源和执行依赖关系集成到异构图中，以预测经验重用前的攻击和任务失败风险。其次，通过匹配反事实重放原始经验和其最小化中性的对应版本，从攻击成功和合法任务完成的差异中推导出任务条件风险标签。最后，在推理时，ExpGuard 修复检索时标记为高风险的经验，并在其进入代理的主动经验上下文前重新预测其风险。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review 创新性地提出经验风险评估和在线修复框架，但未明确评估跨任务泛化能力和复杂对抗场景下的鲁棒性。

LLM_Agent_Memory_Tool_Skill.full_note: Carried-Over and Agent-Native Threats in the Supply Chain of LLM Agent Skills 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Kaixuan Li, Wenbo Guo, Sen Chen, Yang Liu 🏷️ 论文主题 / Primary Topic： LLM_Agent.Tool.Execution 🕒 发布时间： 2026-11-23 16:20:29 UTC 📚 来源： arxiv 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30932 🔗 触发的灵感来源： Subverting Tool Arguments: Defense-Evading Metadata Poisoning in LLM Agents, Epistemic Guard: Out-of-Process MCP Receipt Proxying, Post-Turn Prose Supervision, and Provenance-Gated Memory for Tool-Using Autonomous Agents, Guarding the Kingdom of Skill-Based Agents in the AI Dynasty of Computation: Control-Flow Integrity for Agent Skills 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中的攻击/防御研究不同，本文聚焦于技能供应链中的无意漏洞，而非恶意技能或单一攻击向量。 🧠 核心术语库 [[Dependency Risk]] [[First-Party Code]] [[Agent-Native Threats]] [[CVE]] [[Static Analysis]] [[Sandbox Testing]] 🧭 Motivation & Core Idea 针对 LLM 代理技能供应链中的无意漏洞，论文首次实证研究了从 48,682 个 ClawHub 技能中暴露的攻击面，涵盖依赖项、本地代码、安装指令和凭证等风险，核心思想是识别并测试这些漏洞的可利用性。 🔬 Method 通过静态分析筛选所有技能，人工审查四大检测器标记的 3,428 个案例，并在沙箱和实时 LLM 代理中测试样本技能的可利用性，重点关注依赖项版本漏洞、本地代码缺陷、安装指令和凭证泄露。 💬 锐评 / Critical Review 揭示了技能依赖项和本地代码的严重漏洞，但测试表明多数 CVE 难以被利用，需优先关注本地代码缺陷，而非依赖项警报。

MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.title: Do Agent Societies Develop Intellectual Elites? The Hidden Power Laws of Collective Cognition in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.short_review: 该文极具洞察力，跳出了单纯追求SOTA的工程陷阱，转而从复杂系统动力学视角审视多智能体系统的‘扩展悖论’。其发现的‘智力精英’与‘集成瓶颈’现象，深刻揭示了随规模增长而产生的结构性脆弱——即规模扩大带来的信息熵增与系统整合能力之间的非对称错配。这不仅是实证研究，更是为领域建立了新的理论范式，将研究重心从‘显性性能’引向了‘隐式结构’，对后续设计可扩展、鲁棒的多智能体架构具有奠基意义。
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.full_note: Do Agent Societies Develop Intellectual Elites? The Hidden Power Laws of Collective Cognition in LLM Multi-Agent Systems 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness 👤 作者： Kavana Venkatesh, Jiaming Cui 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-04-03 03:08:07 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.02674v1 🧾 一句话总结： 首次通过大规模实证揭示了多智能体系统集体认知的幂律分布与结构性瓶颈，为解决规模化收益递减问题提供了坚实的理论基础与创新路径。 📄 摘要： Large Language Model (LLM) multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed as interacting agent societies, yet scaling these systems often yields diminishing or unstable returns, the causes of which remain poorly understood. We present the first large-scale empirical study of coordination dynamics in LLM-based multi-agent systems, introducing an atomic event-level formulation that reconstructs reasoning as cascades of coordination. Analyzing over 1.5 Million interactions across tasks, topologies, and scales, we uncover three coupled laws: coordination follows heavy-tailed cascades, concentrates via preferential attachment into intellectual elites, and produces increasingly frequent extreme events as system size grows. We show that these effects are coupled through a single structural mechanism: an integration bottleneck, in which coordination expansion scales with system size while consolidation does not, producing large but weakly integrated reasoning processes. To test this mechanism, we introduce Deficit-Triggered Integration (DTI), which selectively increases integration under imbalance. DTI improves performance precisely where coordination fails, without suppressing large-scale reasoning. Together, our results establish quantitative laws of collective cognition and identify coordination structure as a fundamental, previously unmeasured axis for understanding and improving scalable multi-agent intelligence. 🧠 核心术语库 [[原子事件级公式]] [[智力精英]] [[集成瓶颈]] [[偏好依附]] [[缺陷触发集成(DTI)]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出原子事件级公式重构推理过程，基于跨任务、拓扑和规模的150万次交互数据进行大规模实证分析，揭示了集体认知的幂律定律，定位了‘集成瓶颈’机制，并提出缺陷触发集成（DTI）算法进行验证。 💬 锐评 该文极具洞察力，跳出了单纯追求SOTA的工程陷阱，转而从复杂系统动力学视角审视多智能体系统的‘扩展悖论’。其发现的‘智力精英’与‘集成瓶颈’现象，深刻揭示了随规模增长而产生的结构性脆弱——即规模扩大带来的信息熵增与系统整合能力之间的非对称错配。这不仅是实证研究，更是为领域建立了新的理论范式，将研究重心从‘显性性能’引向了‘隐式结构’，对后续设计可扩展、鲁棒的多智能体架构具有奠基意义。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.title: Efficient LLM Safety Evaluation through Multi-Agent Debate
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.short_review: 该工作精准打击了LLM安全评估中强模型成本过高的痛点，通过多智能体辩论机制巧妙地挖掘了小模型的潜力，具有很高的工程应用价值。然而，该方法引入的多轮推理虽然降低了API调用成本，但增加了Token消耗和推理延迟，在超大规模实时评估场景下的吞吐量仍存疑；此外，小模型固有的语义理解局限可能使其在面对复杂逻辑陷阱时仍难以通过简单辩论完全纠正。
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.full_note: Efficient LLM Safety Evaluation through Multi-Agent Debate 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness 👤 作者： Dachuan Lin, Guobin Shen, Zihao Yang, Tianrong Liu, Dongcheng Zhao, Yi Zeng 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-11-09 14:06:55 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.06396v3 🧾 一句话总结： 提出一种基于多智能体辩论的安全评估框架，结合新基准HAJailBench，在大幅降低成本的同时有效提升了小模型作为评判者的可靠性。 📄 摘要： Safety evaluation of large language models (LLMs) increasingly relies on LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, but strong judges can still be expensive to use at scale. We study whether structured multi-agent debate can improve judge reliability while keeping backbone size and cost modest. To do so, we introduce HAJailBench, a human-annotated jailbreak benchmark with 11,100 labeled interactions spanning diverse attack methods and target models, and we pair it with a Multi-Agent Judge framework in which critic, defender, and judge agents debate under a shared safety rubric. On HAJailBench, the framework improves over matched small-model prompt baselines and prior multi-agent judges, while remaining more economical than GPT-4o under the evaluated pricing snapshot. Ablation results further show that a small number of debate rounds is sufficient to capture most of the gain. Together, these results support structured, value-aligned debate as a practical design for scalable LLM safety evaluation. 🧠 核心术语库 [[LLM-as-a-judge]] [[Multi-Agent Debate]] [[Safety Evaluation]] [[HAJailBench]] [[Jailbreak]] 🔬 核心方法简述 引入包含11,100条人类标注交互的越狱基准HAJailBench，并设计了一个Multi-Agent Judge框架，让批评者、防御者和评判者三个智能体基于共享安全准则进行结构化辩论，旨在以较小规模的模型和成本实现接近GPT-4o级别的评估可靠性。 💬 锐评 该工作精准打击了LLM安全评估中强模型成本过高的痛点，通过多智能体辩论机制巧妙地挖掘了小模型的潜力，具有很高的工程应用价值。然而，该方法引入的多轮推理虽然降低了API调用成本，但增加了Token消耗和推理延迟，在超大规模实时评估场景下的吞吐量仍存疑；此外，小模型固有的语义理解局限可能使其在面对复杂逻辑陷阱时仍难以通过简单辩论完全纠正。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.title: SwarmSys: Decentralized Swarm-Inspired Agents for Scalable and Adaptive Reasoning
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.short_review: 该论文创新性地将群集智能引入LLM推理，通过‘探索-开发-验证’的循环打破了传统固定角色的局限，显著提升了长跨度任务的鲁棒性。其分布式协调机制为解决多智能体协作中的‘扩展性瓶颈’提供了新范式，但需关注大规模通信开销及收敛速度的潜在挑战。
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.full_note: SwarmSys: Decentralized Swarm-Inspired Agents for Scalable and Adaptive Reasoning 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness 👤 作者： Ruohao Li, Hongjun Liu, Leyi Zhao, Zisu Li, Jiawei Li, Jiajun Jiang, Linning Xu, Chen Zhao, Mingming Fan, Chen Liang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-10-11 06:28:22 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.10047v1 🧾 一句话总结： SwarmSys通过群集智能启发的分布式循环机制，实现了无需全局监督的可扩展且自适应的多智能体推理。 📄 摘要： Large language model (LLM) agents have shown remarkable reasoning abilities. However, existing multi-agent frameworks often rely on fixed roles or centralized control, limiting scalability and adaptability in long-horizon reasoning. We introduce SwarmSys, a closed-loop framework for distributed multi-agent reasoning inspired by swarm intelligence. Coordination in SwarmSys emerges through iterative interactions among three specialized roles, Explorers, Workers, and Validators, that continuously cycle through exploration, exploitation, and validation. To enable scalable and adaptive collaboration, we integrate adaptive agent and event profiles, embedding-based probabilistic matching, and a pheromone-inspired reinforcement mechanism, supporting dynamic task allocation and self-organizing convergence without global supervision. Across symbolic reasoning, research synthesis, and scientific programming tasks, SwarmSys consistently outperforms baselines, improving both accuracy and reasoning stability. These findings highlight swarm-inspired coordination as a promising paradigm for scalable, robust, and adaptive multi-agent reasoning, suggesting that coordination scaling may rival model scaling in advancing LLM intelligence. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Swarm Intelligence (群集智能)]] [[Decentralized Coordination (分布式协调)]] [[Explorers/Workers/Validators (探索者/工作者/验证者)]] [[Pheromone-inspired Reinforcement (受信息素启发的强化)]] [[Adaptive Agent Profiles (自适应智能体档案)]] 🔬 核心方法简述 基于群集智能的分布式闭环框架，包含探索者、工作者、验证者三个角色循环（探索-开发-验证），利用自适应档案、嵌入匹配及信息素强化机制实现动态任务分配与自组织收敛，无需全局监督。 💬 锐评 该论文创新性地将群集智能引入LLM推理，通过‘探索-开发-验证’的循环打破了传统固定角色的局限，显著提升了长跨度任务的鲁棒性。其分布式协调机制为解决多智能体协作中的‘扩展性瓶颈’提供了新范式，但需关注大规模通信开销及收敛速度的潜在挑战。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.title: CREW-WILDFIRE: Benchmarking Agentic Multi-Agent Collaborations at Scale
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.short_review: 该论文通过构建一个更接近真实世界的复杂动态环境，揭示了现有LLM多智能体框架在大规模协调、通信、空间推理和不确定性下的长时程规划方面的显著性能差距，为该领域的研究指明了方向。然而，论文未深入探讨如何解决这些挑战，例如如何设计更有效的通信协议或更鲁棒的规划算法。
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.full_note: CREW-WILDFIRE: Benchmarking Agentic Multi-Agent Collaborations at Scale 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness 👤 作者： Jonathan Hyun, Nicholas R Waytowich, Boyuan Chen 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-07-07 16:33:42 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.05178v2 🧾 一句话总结： CREW-Wildfire为评估大规模多智能体协作的可扩展性、鲁棒性和协调能力提供了一个更真实、更具挑战性的基准测试环境，揭示了现有LLM框架的不足，为未来研究提供了重要基础。 📄 摘要： Despite rapid progress in large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems, current benchmarks fall short in evaluating their scalability, robustness, and coordination capabilities in complex, dynamic, real-world tasks. Existing environments typically focus on small-scale, fully observable, or low-complexity domains, limiting their utility for developing and assessing next-generation multi-agent Agentic AI frameworks. We introduce CREW-Wildfire, an open-source benchmark designed to close this gap. Built atop the human-AI teaming CREW simulation platform, CREW-Wildfire offers procedurally generated wildfire response scenarios featuring large maps, heterogeneous agents, partial observability, stochastic dynamics, and long-horizon planning objectives. The environment supports both low-level control and high-level natural language interactions through modular Perception and Execution modules. We implement and evaluate several state-of-the-art LLM-based multi-agent Agentic AI frameworks, uncovering significant performance gaps that highlight the unsolved challenges in large-scale coordination, communication, spatial reasoning, and long-horizon planning under uncertainty. By providing more realistic complexity, scalable architecture, and behavioral evaluation metrics, CREW-Wildfire establishes a critical foundation for advancing research in scalable multi-agent Agentic intelligence. All code, environments, data, and baselines will be released to support future research in this emerging domain. 🧠 核心术语库 [[CREW-Wildfire基准测试]] [[多智能体协作]] [[部分可观察性]] [[随机动态]] [[长时程规划]] 🔬 核心方法简述 基于CREW模拟平台，设计了一个名为CREW-Wildfire的基准测试环境，通过程序化生成大规模、异构智能体、部分可观察性、随机动态和长时程规划的野火响应场景，评估LLM多智能体协作的可扩展性、鲁棒性和协调能力。 💬 锐评 该论文通过构建一个更接近真实世界的复杂动态环境，揭示了现有LLM多智能体框架在大规模协调、通信、空间推理和不确定性下的长时程规划方面的显著性能差距，为该领域的研究指明了方向。然而，论文未深入探讨如何解决这些挑战，例如如何设计更有效的通信协议或更鲁棒的规划算法。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.title: CodeAgents: A Token-Efficient Framework for Codified Multi-Agent Reasoning in LLMs
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.short_review: 该工作创新性地将伪代码编码范式引入多智能体提示领域，在性能提升与token效率优化上均有显著成果，但局限明显：一是伪代码规范仅适配规划类任务，对开放域动态多智能体协同场景的适配性未做验证；二是未给出伪代码编写的标准化流程，落地时的额外编码成本未被量化评估；三是仅与自然语言提示基线对比，未与AutoGen、MetaGPT等成熟多智能体框架做系统性对标，效率优势的普适性存疑。
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.full_note: CodeAgents: A Token-Efficient Framework for Codified Multi-Agent Reasoning in LLMs 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness 👤 作者： Bruce Yang, Xinfeng He, Huan Gao, Yifan Cao, Xiaofan Li, David Hsu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-07-04 02:20:19 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.03254v1 🧾 一句话总结： 本文提出CodeAgents编码化多智能体推理框架，通过模块化伪代码规范多智能体全交互流程，在提升多智能体规划性能的同时大幅降低token消耗，为高可扩展、高token效率的多智能体LLM系统提供了新型提示范式。 📄 摘要： Effective prompt design is essential for improving the planning capabilities of large language model (LLM)-driven agents. However, existing structured prompting strategies are typically limited to single-agent, plan-only settings, and often evaluate performance solely based on task accuracy - overlooking critical factors such as token efficiency, modularity, and scalability in multi-agent environments. To address these limitations, we introduce CodeAgents, a prompting framework that codifies multi-agent reasoning and enables structured, token-efficient planning in multi-agent systems. In CodeAgents, all components of agent interaction - Task, Plan, Feedback, system roles, and external tool invocations - are codified into modular pseudocode enriched with control structures (e.g., loops, conditionals), boolean logic, and typed variables. This design transforms loosely connected agent plans into cohesive, interpretable, and verifiable multi-agent reasoning programs. We evaluate the proposed framework across three diverse benchmarks - GAIA, HotpotQA, and VirtualHome - using a range of representative LLMs. Results show consistent improvements in planning performance, with absolute gains of 3-36 percentage points over natural language prompting baselines. On VirtualHome, our method achieves a new state-of-the-art success rate of 56%. In addition, our approach reduces input and output token usage by 55-87% and 41-70%, respectively, underscoring the importance of token-aware evaluation metrics in the development of scalable multi-agent LLM systems. The code and resources are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CodifyingAgent-5A86 🧠 核心术语库 [[Codified Multi-Agent Reasoning]] [[Token-Efficient Multi-Agent Prompting]] [[Modular Agent Interaction Pseudocode]] [[Structured Multi-Agent Planning]] 🔬 核心方法简述 将智能体交互的全组件（任务、计划、反馈、系统角色、外部工具调用）编码为融入控制结构、布尔逻辑、类型变量的模块化伪代码，将松散的多智能体计划转化为可解释、可验证的多智能体推理程序，实现结构化且token高效的多智能体规划。 💬 锐评 该工作创新性地将伪代码编码范式引入多智能体提示领域，在性能提升与token效率优化上均有显著成果，但局限明显：一是伪代码规范仅适配规划类任务，对开放域动态多智能体协同场景的适配性未做验证；二是未给出伪代码编写的标准化流程，落地时的额外编码成本未被量化评估；三是仅与自然语言提示基线对比，未与AutoGen、MetaGPT等成熟多智能体框架做系统性对标，效率优势的普适性存疑。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.full_note: Very Large-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation in AgentScope 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness 👤 作者： Xuchen Pan, Dawei Gao, Yuexiang Xie, Yushuo Chen, Zhewei Wei, Yaliang Li, Bolin Ding, Ji-Rong Wen, Jingren Zhou 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2024-07-25 05:50:46 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.17789v2 🧾 一句话总结： AgentScope通过创新的分布式架构和自动化工具链，为大规模多智能体模拟提供了可扩展、易用的平台框架 📄 摘要： Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have opened new avenues for applying multi-agent systems in very large-scale simulations. However, there remain several challenges when conducting multi-agent simulations with existing platforms, such as limited scalability and low efficiency, unsatisfied agent diversity, and effort-intensive management processes. To address these challenges, we develop several new features and components for AgentScope, a user-friendly multi-agent platform, enhancing its convenience and flexibility for supporting very large-scale multi-agent simulations. Specifically, we propose an actor-based distributed mechanism as the underlying technological infrastructure towards great scalability and high efficiency, and provide flexible environment support for simulating various real-world scenarios, which enables parallel execution of multiple agents, automatic workflow conversion for distributed deployment, and both inter-agent and agent-environment interactions. Moreover, we integrate an easy-to-use configurable tool and an automatic background generation pipeline in AgentScope, simplifying the process of creating agents with diverse yet detailed background settings. Last but not least, we provide a web-based interface for conveniently monitoring and managing a large number of agents that might deploy across multiple devices. We conduct a comprehensive simulation to demonstrate the effectiveness of these proposed enhancements in AgentScope, and provide detailed observations and insightful discussions to highlight the great potential of applying multi-agent systems in large-scale simulations. The source code is released on GitHub at https://github.com/modelscope/agentscope/tree/main/examples/paper_large_scale_simulation to inspire further research and development in large-scale multi-agent simulations. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Actor-based Distributed Mechanism]] [[Agent Diversity Generation]] [[Scalable Simulation Framework]] [[Distributed Deployment Automation]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出基于actor的分布式机制实现高扩展性与效率，开发灵活环境支持系统实现多场景模拟，集成自动化背景生成管道与可视化监控界面，通过并行执行、分布式部署和交互机制优化大规模多智能体系统 💬 锐评 未明确提及系统容错机制与异构计算资源调度策略，实际应用场景验证不足，LLM推理延迟对实时性的影响分析缺失 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.full_note: Internet of Agents: Weaving a Web of Heterogeneous Agents for Collaborative Intelligence 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness 👤 作者： Weize Chen, Ziming You, Ran Li, Yitong Guan, Chen Qian, Chenyang Zhao, Cheng Yang, Ruobing Xie, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2024-07-09 17:33:24 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.07061v2 🧾 一句话总结： IoA通过类即时通信架构和动态协作机制为异构LLM智能体的规模化互联提供了新范式，是多智能体系统从单生态向开放网络演进的重要探索。 📄 摘要： The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has paved the way for the development of highly capable autonomous agents. However, existing multi-agent frameworks often struggle with integrating diverse capable third-party agents due to reliance on agents defined within their own ecosystems. They also face challenges in simulating distributed environments, as most frameworks are limited to single-device setups. Furthermore, these frameworks often rely on hard-coded communication pipelines, limiting their adaptability to dynamic task requirements. Inspired by the concept of the Internet, we propose the Internet of Agents (IoA), a novel framework that addresses these limitations by providing a flexible and scalable platform for LLM-based multi-agent collaboration. IoA introduces an agent integration protocol, an instant-messaging-like architecture design, and dynamic mechanisms for agent teaming and conversation flow control. Through extensive experiments on general assistant tasks, embodied AI tasks, and retrieval-augmented generation benchmarks, we demonstrate that IoA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, showcasing its ability to facilitate effective collaboration among heterogeneous agents. IoA represents a step towards linking diverse agents in an Internet-like environment, where agents can seamlessly collaborate to achieve greater intelligence and capabilities. Our codebase has been released at \url{https://github.com/OpenBMB/IoA}. 🧠 核心术语库 [[异构智能体集成协议]] [[即时通信类架构]] [[动态智能体组队]] [[对话流控制]] [[分布式多智能体协作]] 🔬 核心方法简述 IoA框架通过三方面解决多智能体协作瓶颈：1）提出智能体集成协议实现异构第三方智能体的即插即用；2） 采用类即时通信的分布式架构支持跨设备模拟；3）引入动态智能体组队和对话流控制机制替代硬编码管道。 💬 锐评 论文的核心贡献是工程架构层面的创新（类IM架构设计），但方法论层面缺乏突破性理论贡献。实验部分在通用助手和RAG任务上的基线对比不够充分，未清晰说明相比ChatDev、MetaGPT等框架的具体提升幅度。此外，动态组队机制的具体实现细节和决策逻辑披露有限。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.title: LongAgent: Scaling Language Models to 128k Context through Multi-Agent Collaboration
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.short_review: 该工作巧妙利用多智能体协作的“分布式”特性绕过了单模型长上下文窗口的硬性限制，并针对协作中的幻觉冲突提出了通信缓解机制。然而，从效率和鲁棒性角度来看，引入数十至数百个Agent进行通信必然导致推理延迟和Token消耗剧增，摘要中未体现对这种高通信开销的评估；此外，依赖Leader从充满幻觉的成员响应中聚合信息，在面对更深层次的复杂逻辑推理时，系统鲁棒性可能面临严峻挑战。
MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness.full_note: LongAgent: Scaling Language Models to 128k Context through Multi-Agent Collaboration 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Scaling_Efficiency_Robustness 👤 作者： Jun Zhao, Can Zu, Hao Xu, Yi Lu, Wei He, Yiwen Ding, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2024-02-18 11:46:52 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.11550v2 🧾 一句话总结： 提出基于Leader-Member架构和成员间通信机制的LongAgent，通过小模型多智能体协作低成本处理128k长文本，在检索和多跳问答任务上展现出超越GPT-4的潜力。 📄 摘要： Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in understanding language and executing complex reasoning tasks. However, LLMs with long context windows have been notorious for their expensive training costs and high inference latency. Even the most advanced models such as GPT-4 and Claude2 often make mistakes when processing inputs of over $100k$ tokens, a phenomenon also known as \textit{lost in the middle}. In this paper, we propose \textsc{LongAgent}, a method based on multi-agent collaboration, which scales LLMs (e.g., LLaMA) to a context of 128K and demonstrates potential superiority in long-text processing compared to GPT-4. In \textsc{LongAgent}, a leader is responsible for understanding user intent and directing team members to acquire information from documents. Due to members' hallucinations, it is non-trivial for a leader to obtain accurate information from the responses of dozens to hundreds of members. To address this, we develop an \textit{inter-member communication} mechanism to resolve response conflicts caused by hallucinations through information sharing. Our experimental results indicate that \textsc{LongAgent} offers a promising alternative for long-text processing. The agent team instantiated with LLaMA-7B achieves significant improvements in tasks such as 128k-long text retrieval, multi-hop question answering, compared to GPT-4. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Multi-Agent Collaboration]] [[Leader-Member Architecture]] [[Inter-member Communication]] [[Lost in the middle]] [[Hallucination Mitigation]] 🔬 核心方法简述 采用Leader-Member多智能体架构处理长文本，Leader负责理解意图并分配任务，Member负责从文档获取信息；针对成员幻觉导致的信息冲突，设计了成员间通信机制，通过信息共享解决冲突以提取准确信息，从而实现用小模型（如LLaMA-7B）协作处理128k上下文。 💬 锐评 该工作巧妙利用多智能体协作的“分布式”特性绕过了单模型长上下文窗口的硬性限制，并针对协作中的幻觉冲突提出了通信缓解机制。然而，从效率和鲁棒性角度来看，引入数十至数百个Agent进行通信必然导致推理延迟和Token消耗剧增，摘要中未体现对这种高通信开销的评估；此外，依赖Leader从充满幻觉的成员响应中聚合信息，在面对更深层次的复杂逻辑推理时，系统鲁棒性可能面临严峻挑战。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.title: Towards Autonomous Formulaic Alpha Discovery: An Evolutionary Computation Perspective
MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.short_review: 该文是领域集大成之作，敏锐捕捉到当前Alpha发现研究中GP、RL、GFlowNets、LLM等方法论割裂的痛点，首次以演化计算为'元语言'统一了异构算法家族。其提出的'演化自主性'极具前瞻性，直指从人工调参向自适应系统进阶的必然趋势。然而，将LLM智能体等生成式模型强行纳入传统EC的'表示-变异'框架可能存在颗粒度不匹配的理论风险（如LLM的隐式变异算子难以被传统框架完全解释），这一统一视角的有效性取决于能否切实指导跨范式组件的底层融合，而非仅仅提供一种分类学的快感。
MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.full_note: Towards Autonomous Formulaic Alpha Discovery: An Evolutionary Computation Perspective 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure 👤 作者： Xinwei Yu, Yiyang Fu, Mingcheng Fan, Enqi Li, Yilin Gao, Shugong Xu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-03 07:02:24 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01789v1 🧾 一句话总结： 作为首篇从演化计算视角统一自动化Alpha发现方法的理论综述，通过六组件分析与八维评估体系，为构建可靠、自适应、可解释的自主发现系统奠定了系统性的理论基石。 📄 摘要： Automated formulaic alpha discovery aims to generate predictive and interpretable trading signals from large symbolic factor spaces. Its effectiveness is constrained by noisy fitness estimates, market nonstationarity, costly backtesting, semantic redundancy, and conflicting practical objectives. Existing studies employ diverse techniques, including genetic programming (GP), evolutionary algorithms (EAs), reinforcement learning (RL), generative flow networks (GFlowNets), Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS), large language models (LLMs), and agentic workflows, but generally examine them as separate algorithmic families. This article introduces, for the first time, a unified evolutionary computation (EC) perspective on automated formulaic alpha discovery, formulating it as a noisy, dynamic, and multiobjective symbolic evolutionary optimization problem. A six-component analytical framework is developed to characterize existing methods through representation, variation, fitness evaluation, selection, memory, and adaptation. Furthermore, an eight-dimensional, autonomy-oriented evaluation framework is proposed, covering search efficiency, fitness reliability, residual alpha quality, economic diversity, tradability, evolutionary autonomy, robustness to nonstationarity, and reproducibility. As large language model (LLM)-based agents become more autonomous and increasingly delegate tasks across organizational boundaries, securing them evolves from a single challenge into a broad and interconnected landscape spanning the entire agentic stack. In multi-agent settings, delegation and communication introduce challenges related to identity, trust, capability control, and decision transparency, while the underlying model routing and execution control plane remains vulnerable to manipulation and to unverified model provenance. Perhaps the most fundamental challenge is behavioral containment: sequences of individually permissible actions may collectively violate system-level constraints and safety invariants. At the broader level, supply-chain integrity, provenance, accountability, and end-to-end observability remain largely open problems. A common principle unifies these directions: security must become a verifiable property of the architectures, protocols, and runtimes that govern agent behavior, rather than an optional layer of guidance. While MAS can lead to improved task performance by decomposing complex tasks across specialized sub-agents, such role decomposition introduces new structural attack surfaces that are absent in SAS. This expanded attack surface remains poorly understood and inadequately categorized.   To address this, we propose a taxonomy to categorize attack vectors specific to web-based MAS, accounting for vulnerabilities introduced or amplified by the involvement of multiple agents. We further present a test-bed WebMASLab to analyze web agent security against a fully external, web-only adversary. To isolate the effect of architecture, we keep the user task, tool surface, and browser substrate fixed, and compare single- and multi-agent setups. We evaluate three adversarial scenarios, across three conditions (baseline, prompt-hardened, and reasoning-enabled), including a novel MAS-specific Telephone Loop attack that exploits cross-agent delegation to create cyclical task loops. The attack is inert against SAS but compromises MAS when powered by three of the four frontier models evaluated (Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5.2, GPT-5.4), averaging 80% across them at baseline. Only the fourth model, Claude Sonnet 4.6, resists the attack with a 92% detection rate. For the rest, the detection is 0% at baseline, reaching 33% with prompt-hardening for one model. We also show that obvious defenses do not generalize; prompt-hardening collapses one model's ASR from 100% to 8% while providing only modest reduction to the others. Our findings demonstrate that the transition from single- to multi-agent web systems changes the security landscape. Role specialization may not only lead to performance optimization but also introduce new architectural risks that require further study and defenses. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Attack Surface Evolution（攻击面演变）]] [[Multi-Agent Systems（多代理系统）]] [[Taxonomy（攻击向量分类法）]] [[Telephone Loop Attack（电话循环攻击）]] [[Prompt-Hardening（提示强化防御）]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出针对多代理系统的攻击向量分类法，构建WebMASLab测试平台，通过对比单代理与多代理系统在三种对抗场景（基线/提示强化/推理启用）下的安全性，重点分析新型Telephone Loop攻击的跨代理委托漏洞 💬 锐评 实验局限于特定前沿模型（Claude Sonnet系列/GPT-5系列），未覆盖更广泛的LLM生态；攻击场景是否完全穷举？防御有效性存在模型依赖性，需验证泛化能力；未探讨代理间通信加密等基础防护措施 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.full_note: Stateful Cooperative Agents Safeguarding LLMs Against Evolving Multi-Turn Attacks 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure 👤 作者： Siyuan Li, Zehao Liu, Haoyu Li, Xi Lin, Ning Liu, Jun Wu, Jianhua Li, Mohsen Guizani 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-07-31 14:04:49 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00134v1 🧾 一句话总结： 提出将多智能体合作与disruption/misdirection/adaptation策略结合的LLM主动防御框架，在EMRA数据集上显著降低ASR并提高攻击成本，是多智能体系统应用于安全防御的有益探索，但需更多真实场景验证。 📄 摘要： As LLMs become increasingly integrated into complex applications, their vulnerability to adversarial attacks has raised significant concerns. However, existing defenses remain reactive in nature. This limitation makes it difficult for them to counter sophisticated threats, as adversaries continuously adjust their strategies across multi-turn interactions. In this paper, we present a proactive defense framework for securing LLMs against evolving multi-turn adversarial attacks that combines disruption, misdirection, and adaptation across successive interaction turns. In particular, it employs a cooperative multi-agent architecture in which specialized agents execute complementary defense strategies. These strategies include controlled response pacing to increase attack costs, strategically ambiguous outputs to mislead adversaries into ineffective strategies, and forensic analysis of interaction logs to identify attack patterns and refine defenses. These agents are coordinated by an adaptive mechanism that dynamically adjusts the defense strategy in response to escalating threats. To facilitate comprehensive evaluation, we present the EMRA dataset designed to simulate evolving strategies across multi-turn attacks, including 5,200 adversarial samples across eight attack types. Experimental results on EMRA across multiple LLM backbones show that the proposed framework reduces ASR by 69% on average relative to evaluated state-of-the-art baselines. Beyond suppressing harmful outputs, it sustains deceptive engagement, achieving an average DR more than six times that of the strongest baselines and increasing attacker-token consumption by 198.83% on average relative to evaluated baselines. MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.title: QueenBee Planner: Skill-Evolving Communication Topologies for Token-Efficient LLM Multi-Agent Systems
MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.short_review: 将多智能体通信拓扑从静态手工设计转化为动态可进化的“设计技能”是该领域的重要突破，多重防退化机制设计展现了严谨的工程思考。然而，其实验场景（Count-Frequency、Silo-Bench）偏向特定的信息聚合与分布式协调任务，在应对复杂开放域推理时，外层Planner生成DAG的计算开销及规则迁移的泛化能力仍存疑；此外，冻结底层Worker的设定可能忽略了异构智能体联合进化的更大潜力。

This paper introduces QueenBee Planner, a framework that treats inter-agent communication topology as a retrievable and self-improving design skill. A pool of worker agents, the task adapter, and the scoring function are frozen; only an outer LLM planner learns to generate temporal communication DAGs specifying who sends information to whom, in which round, who merges messages, and who emits the final answer. Execution traces are distilled into evidence-backed design rules with three actions: \emph{Preserve}, \emph{Modify}, and \emph{Avoid}. To prevent self-evolution from turning lucky runs or plausible but false explanations into policy, QueenBee uses held-out acceptance gates, variance-aware credit, motif-level attribution, transfer trust, insight falsification, and structural deduplication. We evaluate the method on Count-Frequency aggregation and Silo-Bench-style distributed coordination tasks. With fixed workers, self-evolved graph generation produces communication structures that improve over fixed topologies and cold generation. In the CF fulltest setting, the best generated graph reduces RMSE from 12.53 for the strongest fixed topology to 7.87 while also reducing messages, model calls, and token cost; Silo-style results show the same direction of improvement over cold and fixed-topology baselines. These results suggest that multi-agent systems can learn reusable architectural design knowledge rather than merely memorizing task answers. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Temporal Communication DAG]] [[Self-evolving Design Skill]] [[Motif-level Attribution]] [[Variance-aware Credit]] [[Held-out Acceptance Gates]] 🔬 核心方法简述 冻结底层工作智能体与评分函数，由外层LLM Planner学习生成时序通信DAG。通过将执行轨迹提炼为“保留/修改/避免”的设计规则实现拓扑自我进化，并引入留出验证、方差感知信用分配、基序级归因及结构去重等机制防止策略退化，从而学习可复用的架构设计知识。 💬 锐评 将多智能体通信拓扑从静态手工设计转化为动态可进化的“设计技能”是该领域的重要突破，多重防退化机制设计展现了严谨的工程思考。然而，其实验场景（Count-Frequency、Silo-Bench）偏向特定的信息聚合与分布式协调任务，在应对复杂开放域推理时，外层Planner生成DAG的计算开销及规则迁移的泛化能力仍存疑；此外，冻结底层Worker的设定可能忽略了异构智能体联合进化的更大潜力。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.title: The Devil Behind Moltbook: Anthropic Safety is Always Vanishing in Self-Evolving AI Societies
MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.short_review: 该文极具颠覆性，直接刺破了多智能体系统'闭环进化'的乌托邦泡沫。它指出了一个残酷的信息论事实：没有外部人类反馈的熵减介入，系统内部的自我博弈只会制造'统计盲点'，导致价值对齐不可逆地坍塌。这不仅是对技术路线的修正，更是对'完全自治AI'设想的根本性否定，将安全讨论从工程修补提升到了动力学原理层面。
MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.full_note: The Devil Behind Moltbook: Anthropic Safety is Always Vanishing in Self-Evolving AI Societies 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure 👤 作者： Chenxu Wang, Chaozhuo Li, Songyang Liu, Zejian Chen, Jinyu Hou, Ji Qi, Rui Li, Litian Zhang, Qiwei Ye, Zheng Liu, Xu Chen, Xi Zhang, Philip S. Yu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-02-10 15:18:19 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09877v2 🧾 一句话总结： 揭示了封闭自进化系统中安全性必然退化的动力学机制，为多智能体系统的能力边界建立了理论红线。 📄 摘要： The emergence of multi-agent systems built from large language models (LLMs) offers a promising paradigm for scalable collective intelligence and self-evolution. Ideally, such systems would achieve continuous self-improvement in a fully closed loop while maintaining robust safety alignment--a combination we term the self-evolution trilemma. However, we demonstrate both theoretically and empirically that an agent society satisfying continuous self-evolution, complete isolation, and safety invariance is impossible. Drawing on an information-theoretic framework, we formalize safety as the divergence degree from anthropic value distributions. We theoretically demonstrate that isolated self-evolution induces statistical blind spots, leading to the irreversible degradation of the system's safety alignment. Empirical and qualitative results from an open-ended agent community (Moltbook) and two closed self-evolving systems reveal phenomena that align with our theoretical prediction of inevitable safety erosion. We further propose several solution directions to alleviate the identified safety concern. Our work establishes a fundamental limit on the self-evolving AI societies and shifts the discourse from symptom-driven safety patches to a principled understanding of intrinsic dynamical risks, highlighting the need for external oversight or novel safety-preserving mechanisms. 🧠 核心术语库 [[自进化三难困境]] [[统计盲点]] [[安全性消蚀]] [[人类价值分布]] [[闭环自进化]] 🔬 核心方法简述 构建信息论框架，将安全性定义为智能体输出分布与人类价值分布的偏离度；通过理论推导证明隔离环境下的自进化会产生'统计盲点'，并利用Moltbook开放社区及两个封闭系统进行实证验证。 💬 锐评 该文极具颠覆性，直接刺破了多智能体系统'闭环进化'的乌托邦泡沫。它指出了一个残酷的信息论事实：没有外部人类反馈的熵减介入，系统内部的自我博弈只会制造'统计盲点'，导致价值对齐不可逆地坍塌。这不仅是对技术路线的修正，更是对'完全自治AI'设想的根本性否定，将安全讨论从工程修补提升到了动力学原理层面。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.short_review: 这篇论文是对当前盲目乐观的“自我反思/进化”流派的一记当头棒喝，揭示了现有Agent往往处于“伪进化”状态：虽然依赖原始数据，却无法真正理解和利用精炼后的经验（摘要/反思）。这意味着大量计算资源消耗在生成无效的浓缩经验上，现有的Memory和Reflection机制亟需重构。
MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure.full_note: Large Language Model Agents Are Not Always Faithful Self-Evolvers 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Evolution_Adaptive_Structure 👤 作者： Weixiang Zhao, Yingshuo Wang, Yichen Zhang, Yang Deng, Yanyan Zhao, Wanxiang Che, Bing Qin, Ting Liu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-01-30 01:05:15 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22436v3 🧾 一句话总结： 首次系统性揭示自进化智能体存在对浓缩经验利用失效的根本性缺陷，挑战了领域内关于经验重用机制的普遍假设。 📄 摘要： Self-evolving large language model (LLM) agents continually improve by accumulating and reusing past experience, yet it remains unclear whether they faithfully rely on that experience to guide their behavior. We present the first systematic investigation of experience faithfulness, the causal dependence of an agent's decisions on the experience it is given, in self-evolving LLM agents. Using controlled causal interventions on both raw and condensed forms of experience, we comprehensively evaluate four representative frameworks across 13 LLM backbones and 9 environments. Our analysis uncovers a striking asymmetry: while agents consistently depend on raw experience, they often disregard or misinterpret condensed experience, even when it is the only experience provided. This gap persists across single- and multi-agent configurations and across backbone scales. We trace its underlying causes to three factors: the semantic limitations of condensed content, internal processing biases that suppress experience, and task regimes where pretrained priors already suffice. These findings challenge prevailing assumptions about self-evolving methods and underscore the need for more faithful and reliable approaches to experience integration. 🧠 核心术语库 [[经验忠实度]] [[自进化智能体]] [[因果干预]] [[浓缩经验]] [[预训练先验]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出“经验忠实度”这一因果评估指标，通过受控因果干预操纵原始经验和浓缩经验，系统评估了4种代表性自进化框架在13个LLM骨干和9种环境下的表现，以量化智能体决策对给定经验的依赖程度。 💬 锐评 这篇论文是对当前盲目乐观的“自我反思/进化”流派的一记当头棒喝，揭示了现有Agent往往处于“伪进化”状态：虽然依赖原始数据，却无法真正理解和利用精炼后的经验（摘要/反思）。这意味着大量计算资源消耗在生成无效的浓缩经验上，现有的Memory和Reflection机制亟需重构。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Yet this very sophistication amplifies their fragility, making them more prone to system failure. Pinpointing the specific agent or step responsible for an error within long execution traces defines the task of agentic system failure attribution. Current state-of-the-art reasoning LLMs, however, remain strikingly inadequate for this challenge, with accuracy generally below 10%. To address this gap, we propose AgenTracer, the first automated framework for annotating failed multi-agent trajectories via counterfactual replay and programmed fault injection, producing the curated dataset TracerTraj. Leveraging this resource, we develop AgenTracer-8B, a lightweight failure tracer trained with multi-granular reinforcement learning, capable of efficiently diagnosing errors in verbose multi-agent interactions. On the Who&When benchmark, AgenTracer-8B outperforms giant proprietary LLMs like Gemini-2.5-Pro and Claude-4-Sonnet by up to 18.18%, setting a new standard in LLM agentic failure attribution. More importantly, AgenTracer-8B delivers actionable feedback to off-the-shelf multi-agent systems like MetaGPT and MaAS with 4.8-14.2% performance gains, empowering self-correcting and self-evolving agentic AI. 🧠 核心术语库 [[AgenTracer]] [[反事实重放]] [[程序化故障注入]] [[多粒度强化学习]] [[AgenTracer-8B]] [[故障归因]] 🔬 核心方法简述 核心方法简述：AgenTracer通过反事实重放和程序化故障注入来标注失败的多人轨迹，并开发AgenTracer-8B模型，采用多粒度强化学习进行故障诊断。 💬 锐评 批判性锐评：该论文提出了创新性的方法来解决LLM智能体系统的故障归因问题，但反事实重放和故障注入的效率及泛化能力可能受限于具体实现和场景复杂度。此外，AgenTracer-8B的性能提升是否可持续到更复杂的实际场景中仍需进一步验证。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.short_review: 该论文首次将多智能体框架应用于动态图推理，思路创新。但需注意：(1) 论文声称的'超过90%准确率'是在特定实验设置下，真实场景效果有待验证；(2) 时空解耦的具体实现细节在摘要中披露有限；(3) 作为'首个'该方向工作，缺乏对比基线的充分性值得商榷；(4) 90%准确率的具体任务类型（节点分类？边预测？）需要读者进一步查阅正文确认。
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.full_note: AdaSTORM: Scaling LLM Reasoning on Dynamic Graphs via Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Multi-Agent Collaboration 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision 👤 作者： Bing Hao, Ruijie Wang, Haodong Qian, Yunlong Chu, Yuhang Liu, Yumeng Lin, Minglai Shao, Jianxin Li 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-06-15 07:32:44 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16328v1 🧾 一句话总结： AdaSTORM首次提出多智能体协作框架解决LLM在动态图上的扩展瓶颈，通过自适应分区+时空解耦智能体架构实现千节点图的高精度推理，是LLM+图推理领域的重要前沿突破。 📄 摘要： Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable potential in dynamic graph reasoning, but suffer from a scaling bottleneck: current models can only handle graphs with tens of nodes, constrained by exponential reasoning overhead and finite context windows. While multi-agent systems (MAS) offer collective reasoning and topology-aware orchestration, capabilities naturally suited for graph-structured tasks, their application to dynamic graphs remains unexplored. This paper presents Scaling LLM Reasoning on Dynamic Graphs via Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Multi-Agent Collaboration (AdaSTORM), a framework that reformulates large-scale dynamic graph reasoning into two stages: (i) Adaptive Partitioning, partitioning large-scale dynamic graphs into subregions that match the model's reasoning capacity while minimizing inference cost; and (ii) Collaborative Reasoning, aligning graph partition topologies with a spatio-temporal decoupled multi-agent architecture. AdaSTORM is the first multi-agent framework tailored for dynamic graph reasoning. Extensive experiments show that AdaSTORM successfully breaks through the scaling bottleneck, scaling reasoning to thousand-node graphs with over 90% accuracy across several large-scale dynamic graph settings without external tools, significantly outperforms seven competitive baselines. Furthermore, it achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on existing benchmarks and generalizes robustly to real-world datasets. The source code is available at: https://github.com/irisorchid107/AdaSTORM/. 🧠 核心术语库 [[动态图推理]] [[多智能体系统MAS]] [[自适应分区]] [[时空解耦]] [[LLM扩展瓶颈]] [[拓扑感知编排]] [[集体推理]] 🔬 核心方法简述 Ada STORM将大规模动态图推理分解为两个核心阶段：(1) 自适应分区阶段，将大图分割为匹配LLM推理能力的子图块，最小化推理成本；(2) 协作推理阶段，采用时空解耦的多智能体架构，让智能体与图分区拓扑对齐，实现集体推理。 💬 锐评 该论文首次将多智能体框架应用于动态图推理，思路创新。但需注意：(1) 论文声称的'超过90%准确率'是在特定实验设置下，真实场景效果有待验证；(2) 时空解耦的具体实现细节在摘要中披露有限；(3) 作为'首个'该方向工作，缺乏对比基线的充分性值得商榷；(4) 90%准确率的具体任务类型（节点分类？边预测？）需要读者进一步查阅正文确认。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.title: SensingAgents: A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework for Robust IMU Activity Recognition
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.short_review: 将LLM多智能体辩证辩论机制引入物理传感器（IMU）数据处理极具创新性，有效缓解了传统深度学习HAR对标注数据的依赖和黑盒问题。然而，该方法在应对高频时序信号时严重依赖LLM的解析能力，且多智能体通信与辩论势必带来极高的推理延迟和计算成本，在资源受限的移动设备或实时感知场景中落地面临巨大挑战。

However, current deep learning-based HAR models often struggle with heavy reliance on labeled data, position-specific ambiguity, and a lack of transparent reasoning. Inspired by the advanced agents framework, which emulates a collaborative agent using Large Language Models (LLMs), we propose SensingAgents, a novel multi-agent system for robust IMU activity recognition. SensingAgents organizes LLM-powered agents into specialized roles: a group of Analyst Agents for position-specific sensor analysis (arm, wrist, belt, pocket), a pair of Advocate Agents that resolves sensor conflicts through dynamic and static dialectical debates, and a Decision Agent that ensures reliability under sensor drift or failure. Evaluation on the Shoaib dataset demonstrates that SensingAgents significantly outperforms state-of-the-art single-agent and multi-agent LLM models, achieving an accuracy of 79.5% in a zero setting--29% higher than existing agent models and 9.4% higher than deep learning baselines--particularly in complex scenarios where multi-sensor data is conflicting or noisy. Our work highlights the potential of multi-agent collaborative reasoning for advancing the robustness and interpretability of ubiquitous sensing systems. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Human Activity Recognition (HAR)]] [[IMU sensors]] [[Multi-Agent System]] [[Dialectical Debates]] [[Zero-shot Recognition]] [[Sensor Conflict Resolution]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出SensingAgents多智能体框架，通过Analyst Agents对不同位置的IMU传感器进行特定分析，利用Advocate Agents通过动静辩证辩论解决传感器数据冲突，并由Decision Agent在传感器漂移或故障时保障决策可靠性，实现零样本下的鲁棒活动识别。 💬 锐评 将LLM多智能体辩证辩论机制引入物理传感器（IMU）数据处理极具创新性，有效缓解了传统深度学习HAR对标注数据的依赖和黑盒问题。然而，该方法在应对高频时序信号时严重依赖LLM的解析能力，且多智能体通信与辩论势必带来极高的推理延迟和计算成本，在资源受限的移动设备或实时感知场景中落地面临巨大挑战。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.title: Towards Cognitive Synergy in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems: Integrating Theory of Mind and Critical Evaluation
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.short_review: 论文精准切中了当前LLM-MAS领域'个体强、群体弱'的痛点，指出缺乏高阶认知机制是限制协同效率的核心瓶颈。引入ToM与批判机制是打破Agent间'盲目共识'与'无效复读'僵局的关键理论尝试。然而，摘要层面的宏大叙事需警惕落入'概念包装'陷阱，真正的挑战在于如何将复杂的认知心理学概念（如递归推理）转化为可计算、可量化的LLM推理管线，而非仅停留在Prompt层面的浅层模拟。
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.full_note: Towards Cognitive Synergy in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems: Integrating Theory of Mind and Critical Evaluation 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision 👤 作者： Adam Kostka, Jarosław A. Chudziak 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-07-29 16:16:33 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.21969v1 🧾 一句话总结： 通过心智理论与批判评估机制的深度耦合，构建类人协作推理框架，解决LLM多智能体系统中的认知协同瓶颈，实现系统智能涌现。 📄 摘要： Recently, the field of Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) has gained popularity as researchers are trying to develop artificial intelligence capable of efficient collective reasoning. Agents based on Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well in isolated tasks, yet struggle with higher-order cognition required for adaptive collaboration. Human teams achieve synergy not only through knowledge sharing, but also through recursive reasoning, structured critique, and the ability to infer others' mental states. Current artificial systems lack these essential mechanisms, limiting their ability to engage in sophisticated collective reasoning. This work explores cognitive processes that enable effective collaboration, focusing on adaptive theory of mind (ToM) and systematic critical evaluation. We investigate three key questions. First, how does the ability to model others' perspectives enhance coordination and reduce redundant reasoning? Second, to what extent does structured critique improve reasoning quality by identifying logical gaps and mitigating biases? Third, the interplay of these mechanisms can lead to emergent cognitive synergy, where the collective intelligence of the system exceeds the sum of its parts. Through an empirical case study on complex decision making, we show that the integration of these cognitive mechanisms leads to more coherent, adaptive, and rigorous agent interactions. This article contributes to the field of cognitive science and AI research by presenting a structured framework that emulates human-like collaborative reasoning MAS. It highlights the significance of dynamic ToM and critical evaluation in advancing multi-agent systems' ability to tackle complex, real-world challenges. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Cognitive Synergy]] [[Theory of Mind (ToM)]] [[Critical Evaluation]] [[LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出一种融合自适应心智理论与结构化批判评估的认知协同框架，通过复杂决策任务的实证案例研究，验证Agent间递归推理与纠偏机制的有效性。 💬 锐评 论文精准切中了当前LLM-MAS领域'个体强、群体弱'的痛点，指出缺乏高阶认知机制是限制协同效率的核心瓶颈。引入ToM与批判机制是打破Agent间'盲目共识'与'无效复读'僵局的关键理论尝试。然而，摘要层面的宏大叙事需警惕落入'概念包装'陷阱，真正的挑战在于如何将复杂的认知心理学概念（如递归推理）转化为可计算、可量化的LLM推理管线，而非仅停留在Prompt层面的浅层模拟。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.title: Silence is Not Consensus: Disrupting Agreement Bias in Multi-Agent LLMs via Catfish Agent for Clinical Decision Making
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.short_review: 该研究精准切中了多智能体协作中普遍存在的“回声室效应”与“群体极化”痛点。虽然“唱反调”的思路在逻辑上并不新鲜，但将其具象化为一个可调节的“鲶鱼智能体”并配套复杂度与语气的控制机制，极具工程创新性。特别是在临床决策这一高风险领域，打破盲目共识的价值不亚于提升模型本身的参数能力。然而，该方法的有效性高度依赖于“鲶鱼”自身的批判质量，若异议机制设计不当，极易引发无休止的争论或引入新的噪声，增加推理成本。
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.full_note: Silence is Not Consensus: Disrupting Agreement Bias in Multi-Agent LLMs via Catfish Agent for Clinical Decision Making 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision 👤 作者： Yihan Wang, Qiao Yan, Zhenghao Xing, Lihao Liu, Junjun He, Chi-Wing Fu, Xiaowei Hu, Pheng-Ann Heng 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-05-27 17:59:50 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.21503v1 🧾 一句话总结： 通过引入专门制造异议的“鲶鱼智能体”打破多智能体协作中的“沉默共识”，在医疗决策任务中实现了超越现有顶尖模型的准确率。 📄 摘要： Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong potential in clinical question answering, with recent multi-agent frameworks further improving diagnostic accuracy via collaborative reasoning. However, we identify a recurring issue of Silent Agreement, where agents prematurely converge on diagnoses without sufficient critical analysis, particularly in complex or ambiguous cases. We present a new concept called Catfish Agent, a role-specialized LLM designed to inject structured dissent and counter silent agreement. Inspired by the ``catfish effect'' in organizational psychology, the Catfish Agent is designed to challenge emerging consensus to stimulate deeper reasoning. We formulate two mechanisms to encourage effective and context-aware interventions: (i) a complexity-aware intervention that modulates agent engagement based on case difficulty, and (ii) a tone-calibrated intervention articulated to balance critique and collaboration. Evaluations on nine medical Q&A and three medical VQA benchmarks show that our approach consistently outperforms both single- and multi-agent LLMs frameworks, including leading commercial models such as GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Silent Agreement]] [[Catfish Agent]] [[Catfish Effect]] [[Agreement Bias]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出“鲶鱼智能体”概念，通过组织心理学中的“鲶鱼效应”在多智能体协作中注入结构化异议。核心机制包含基于案例难度的“复杂度感知干预”和平衡批判与协作的“语气校准干预”，旨在打破“沉默共识”，强制激发深层推理。 💬 锐评 该研究精准切中了多智能体协作中普遍存在的“回声室效应”与“群体极化”痛点。虽然“唱反调”的思路在逻辑上并不新鲜，但将其具象化为一个可调节的“鲶鱼智能体”并配套复杂度与语气的控制机制，极具工程创新性。特别是在临床决策这一高风险领域，打破盲目共识的价值不亚于提升模型本身的参数能力。然而，该方法的有效性高度依赖于“鲶鱼”自身的批判质量，若异议机制设计不当，极易引发无休止的争论或引入新的噪声，增加推理成本。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.title: Systematic Failures in Collective Reasoning under Distributed Information in Multi-Agent LLMs
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.short_review: 本文的批判性在于揭示了当前多智能体 LLM 在面对分布式信息时存在普遍的系统性失败，即无法识别或利用未表达的潜在信息，导致决策过早收敛。这种失败并非特定模型或规模的专利，而是跨模型的共性问题，并提出了结构化通信协议作为可行的改进方向。然而，基准任务的构造是否完全捕捉了现实世界中的复杂信息不对称和沟通动态，仍有待进一步验证。
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.full_note: Systematic Failures in Collective Reasoning under Distributed Information in Multi-Agent LLMs 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision 👤 作者： Yuxuan Li, Aoi Naito, Hirokazu Shirado 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-05-15 19:22:54 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.11556v4 🧾 一句话总结： 本文通过实验证明多智能体 LLM 在分布式信息下存在系统性集体推理失败，主要源于无法识别潜在信息不对称，并提出了结构化通信协议作为解决方案，为多智能体系统的信息探索能力提供了理论框架和改进路径。 📄 摘要： Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) are expected to enhance decision-making by pooling distributed information, yet systematically evaluating this capability has remained challenging. We introduce HiddenBench, a 65-task benchmark grounded in the Hidden Profile paradigm, which isolates collective reasoning under distributed information from individual reasoning ability. Evaluating 15 frontier LLMs, we find that multi-agent LLMs achieve only 30.1% accuracy under distributed information, compared to 80.7% accuracy for single agents given complete information. We trace this gap to a systematic failure mode: agents cannot recognize or act under latent information asymmetry -- they fail to reason about what others might know but have not yet expressed, leading to premature convergence on shared evidence while critical distributed facts remain unexplored. These failures persist across prompting strategies, communication depths, and group sizes -- and worsen as groups scale. While some models (e.g., Gemini-2.5-Flash/Pro) outperform others, neither model scale nor individual reasoning accuracy reliably predicts collective performance. We further show that this bottleneck is actionable: a lightweight structured communication protocol substantially improves collective reasoning across model families. Our results identify failures in collective information exploration in decision-making as a key limitation of multi-agent LLMs, and provide a theory-grounded, reproducible framework for diagnosing collective reasoning failures. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Hidden Profile 范式]] [[分布式信息]] [[信息不对称]] [[集体推理]] [[结构化通信协议]] 🔬 核心方法简述 本文提出 HiddenBench，一个基于 Hidden Profile 范式的 65 任务基准，用于评估多智能体 LLM 在分布式信息下的集体推理能力，通过对比单个智能体在完整信息下的表现，识别集体推理的系统性问题。核心方法是设计隔离分布式信息影响的任务，并分析智能体在沟通、推理和信息探索方面的失败模式。 💬 锐评 本文的批判性在于揭示了当前多智能体 LLM 在面对分布式信息时存在普遍的系统性失败，即无法识别或利用未表达的潜在信息，导致决策过早收敛。这种失败并非特定模型或规模的专利，而是跨模型的共性问题，并提出了结构化通信协议作为可行的改进方向。然而，基准任务的构造是否完全捕捉了现实世界中的复杂信息不对称和沟通动态，仍有待进一步验证。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.title: Towards Multi-Agent Reasoning Systems for Collaborative Expertise Delegation: An Exploratory Design Study
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.short_review: 作为冷启动阶段的探索性设计研究，首次系统量化了多智能体LLM协作推理核心设计维度的影响并给出配置指导，但未与领域内既有经典方法开展对比验证，结论普适性有限；同时仅验证了专业知识领域对齐在特定语境推理任务的收益，泛化性不足，且所提及的高效通信协议设计瓶颈尚未得到有效解决
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.full_note: Towards Multi-Agent Reasoning Systems for Collaborative Expertise Delegation: An Exploratory Design Study 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision 👤 作者： Baixuan Xu, Chunyang Li, Weiqi Wang, Wei Fan, Tianshi Zheng, Haochen Shi, Tao Fan, Yangqiu Song, Qiang Yang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-05-12 07:59:13 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.07313v2 🧾 一句话总结： 本研究通过系统性实证探索，明确了多智能体LLM协作推理三个核心设计维度的影响规律，为专业化多智能体系统配置提供实证依据，同时揭示规模化扩展的关键权衡与瓶颈 📄 摘要： Designing effective collaboration structure for multi-agent LLM systems to enhance collective reasoning is crucial yet remains under-explored. In this paper, we systematically investigate how collaborative reasoning performance is affected by three key design dimensions: (1) Expertise-Domain Alignment, (2) Collaboration Paradigm (structured workflow vs. diversity-driven integration), and (3) System Scale. Our findings reveal that expertise alignment benefits are highly domain-contingent, proving most effective for contextual reasoning tasks. Furthermore, collaboration focused on integrating diverse knowledge consistently outperforms rigid task decomposition. Finally, we empirically explore the impact of scaling the multi-agent system with expertise specialization and study the computational trade off, highlighting the need for more efficient communication protocol design. This work provides concrete guidelines for configuring specialized multi-agent system and identifies critical architectural trade-offs and bottlenecks for scalable multi-agent reasoning. MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.full_note: Two Heads are Better Than One: Test-time Scaling of Multi-agent Collaborative Reasoning 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision 👤 作者： Can Jin, Hongwu Peng, Qixin Zhang, Yujin Tang, Dimitris N. Metaxas, Tong Che 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-04-14 00:27:45 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.09772v2 🧾 一句话总结： 通过模型优化与自适应协调机制，在多智能体协作推理领域取得显著效果，为复杂任务解决提供了新范式 📄 摘要： Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs) offer a promising path toward solving complex, real-world tasks that single-agent systems often struggle to manage. While recent advancements in test-time scaling (TTS) have significantly improved single-agent performance on challenging reasoning tasks, how to effectively scale collaboration and reasoning in MAS remains an open question. In this work, we introduce an adaptive multi-agent framework designed to enhance collaborative reasoning through both model-level training and system-level coordination. We construct M500, a high-quality dataset containing 500 multi-agent collaborative reasoning traces, and fine-tune Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct on this dataset to produce M1-32B, a model optimized for multi-agent collaboration. To further enable adaptive reasoning, we propose a novel CEO agent that dynamically manages the discussion process, guiding agent collaboration and adjusting reasoning depth for more effective problem-solving. Evaluated in an open-source MAS across a range of tasks-including general understanding, mathematical reasoning, and coding-our system significantly outperforms strong baselines. For instance, M1-32B achieves 12% improvement on GPQA-Diamond, 41% on AIME2024, and 10% on MBPP-Sanitized, matching the performance of state-of-the-art models like DeepSeek-R1 on some tasks. These results highlight the importance of both learned collaboration and adaptive coordination in scaling multi-agent reasoning. MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.full_note: M-MAD: Multidimensional Multi-Agent Debate for Advanced Machine Translation Evaluation 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision 👤 作者： Zhaopeng Feng, Jiayuan Su, Jiamei Zheng, Jiahan Ren, Yan Zhang, Jian Wu, Hongwei Wang, Zuozhu Liu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2024-12-28 12:11:28 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.20127v3 🧾 一句话总结： M-MAD通过将MQM标准解耦为多维度评估结合多智能体辩论机制，为LLM-as-judge范式在机器翻译评估中提供了新思路，证明了即使使用小型模型也能接近参考型指标的评估能力。 📄 摘要： Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have given rise to the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm, showcasing their potential to deliver human-like judgments. However, in the field of machine translation (MT) evaluation, current LLM-as-a-judge methods fall short of learned automatic metrics. In this paper, we propose Multidimensional Multi-Agent Debate (M-MAD), a systematic LLM-based multi-agent framework for advanced LLM-as-a-judge MT evaluation. Our findings demonstrate that M-MAD achieves significant advancements by (1) decoupling heuristic MQM criteria into distinct evaluation dimensions for fine-grained assessments; (2) employing multi-agent debates to harness the collaborative reasoning capabilities of LLMs; (3) synthesizing dimension-specific results into a final evaluation judgment to ensure robust and reliable outcomes. Comprehensive experiments show that M-MAD not only outperforms all existing LLM-as-a-judge methods but also competes with state-of-the-art reference-based automatic metrics, even when powered by a suboptimal model like GPT-4o mini. Detailed ablations and analysis highlight the superiority of our framework design, offering a fresh perspective for LLM-as-a-judge paradigm. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/SU-JIAYUAN/M-MAD. 🧠 核心术语库 [[LLM-as-Judge]] [[MQM (Multidimensional Quality Metrics)]] [[Multi-Agent Debate]] [[Zero-shot MT Evaluation]] [[Fine-grained Assessment]] [[Collaborative Reasoning]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出M-MAD框架，将 MQM评估标准解耦为多个独立维度（如准确性、流畅性、术语一致性等），每个维度由专门的LLM智能体进行评估，随后通过多智能体辩论机制让各智能体协商讨论，最后综合各维度的评估结果形成最终判断。使用GPT-4o mini等小型模型即可达到与先进参考型指标相当的效果。 💬 锐评 该论文展示了多智能体辩论在机器翻译评估中的潜力，但存在以下局限：(1)实验仅在单一数据集上验证，泛化性存疑；(2)未充分说明多智能体辩论的收敛性和稳定性；(3)与参考型指标比较时未控制变量（如翻译系统数量、语种对覆盖）；(4)框架的额外计算开销与其性能提升是否成正比未讨论。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.short_review: 本质上是基于多轮提示工程的异构集成学习。虽以'心智社会'为理论包装，但其核心依赖人类纠正示例进行跨模型说服，在缺乏高质量先验示例的开放域中泛化能力存疑；此外，多轮异构模型交互带来的高昂Token成本与推理延迟，限制了其在实时场景中的实际落地价值。
MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision.full_note: ReConcile: Round-Table Conference Improves Reasoning via Consensus among Diverse LLMs 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Collective_Reasoning_Decision 👤 作者： Justin Chih-Yao Chen, Swarnadeep Saha, Mohit Bansal 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2023-09-22 17:12:45 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.13007v3 🧾 一句话总结： 提出基于多轮圆桌讨论、相互说服与置信度加权投票的异构多智能体协作框架，通过融合多样性大模型显著提升了复杂推理任务的准确率。 📄 摘要： Large Language Models (LLMs) still struggle with natural language reasoning tasks. Motivated by the society of minds (Minsky, 1988), we propose ReConcile, a multi-model multi-agent framework designed as a round table conference among diverse LLM agents. ReConcile enhances collaborative reasoning between LLM agents via multiple rounds of discussion, learning to convince other agents to improve their answers, and employing a confidence-weighted voting mechanism that leads to a better consensus. In each round, ReConcile initiates discussion between agents via a 'discussion prompt' that consists of (a) grouped answers and explanations generated by each agent in the previous round, (b) their confidence scores, and (c) demonstrations of answer-rectifying human explanations, used for convincing other agents. Experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that ReConcile significantly improves LLMs' reasoning -- both individually and as a team -- surpassing prior single-agent and multi-agent baselines by up to 11.4% and even outperforming GPT-4 on three datasets. ReConcile also flexibly incorporates different combinations of agents, including API-based, open-source, and domain-specific models, leading to an 8% improvement on MATH. Finally, we analyze the individual components of ReConcile, demonstrating that the diversity originating from different models is critical to its superior performance. MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.title: When Outputs Disperse, Does Epistemic Revision Follow? A Black-Box Diagnostic for Machine Collectives
MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.short_review: 这篇论文是针对当前多智能体研究中“为了分歧而分歧”现象的一记警钟。它通过实证数据揭示了智能体系统常见的“形式主义”陷阱：即输出看似多元，实则内里同构（保留虚假前提）。这种对“认知真实性”的量化诊断，将MultiAgent_Communication_Topology的研究从“如何高效/安全传输”提升到了“如何传递真知”的理论高度。然而，其对人工标注的依赖以及对模型内部表征的“黑盒”假设，也限制了其大规模自动化诊断的普适性。

A Black-Box Diagnostic for Machine Collectives 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 👤 作者： Molood Arman 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-04 14:19:59 UTC 🔗 触发的灵感来源： Red-Teaming LLM Multi-Agent Systems via Communication Attacks, Beyond Self-Talk: A Communication-Centric Survey of LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems, Cut the Crap: An Economical Communication Pipeline for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems 🔄 深度差量对比： 与过去笔记中的论文不同，新论文不关注通信的**结构优化**（如AgentPrune的修剪）或**安全攻击**（如AiTM），而是深入探究通信的**语义有效性**。它挑战了“多智能体分歧即意味着群体智慧”的隐含假设，验证了分歧与信念修正之间的因果联系，这直接触及了多智能体系统的认知核心。 🧠 核心术语库 [[Dispersion-Revision Coupling (分歧-修正耦合)]] [[Re-Differentiation Protocol (RDP)]] [[Epistemic Stance (认知立场)]] [[False Premise Recovery (虚假前提恢复)]] [[Meta-Predictive Clarity System (MPCS)]] 🔬 方法论简析 提出“分歧-修正耦合”诊断框架，利用Coherence Index (CI)量化输出空间的离散度，并通过Re-Differentiation Protocol (RDP)强制触发分歧。通过双通道测量（输出通道验证分散程度 vs 认知通道验证信念修正），构建黑盒诊断工具以评估群体是否真正实现了认知升级而非形式上的“假性分歧”。 💬 锐评 这篇论文是针对当前多智能体研究中“为了分歧而分歧”现象的一记警钟。它通过实证数据揭示了智能体系统常见的“形式主义”陷阱：即输出看似多元，实则内里同构（保留虚假前提）。这种对“认知真实性”的量化诊断，将MultiAgent_Communication_Topology的研究从“如何高效/安全传输”提升到了“如何传递真知”的理论高度。然而，其对人工标注的依赖以及对模型内部表征的“黑盒”假设，也限制了其大规模自动化诊断的普适性。

MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.short_review: 该文精准切中LLM辅助因果发现'重性能轻解释'的痛点，将'决策可追溯性'形式化为核心需求极具前瞻性。虽然摘要显示其性能仅与SOTA LLM方法相当，但在真实世界无真值场景下，100%的可解释性价值远超微小的指标提升。需警惕其对三节点模体的依赖可能限制复杂高阶交互的发现能力。
MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.full_note: GENESIS: Towards Explainable Causal Discovery 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Communication_Topology 👤 作者： Abhinav Thorat, Ravi Kumar Kolla, Vishak K Bhat, Harsh Vardhan Singh Chauhan, Niranjan Pedanekar 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-04 16:09:01 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03868v1 🧾 一句话总结： 将可解释性作为因果发现的一等公民，通过结构模体先验与分层证据审计，在不牺牲性能的前提下解决了LLM辅助方法中'为何有边'的信任危机。 📄 摘要： Causal Discovery (CD) from observational data faces two fundamental challenges. First, purely statistical methods often lack the power to resolve structural ambiguities in low-sample regimes. Second, although LLM-assisted hybrid approaches improve structure recovery through semantic reasoning, the influence of that reasoning on individual edge decisions remains largely opaque. Consequently, existing hybrid methods fail to satisfy a fundamental requirement: explaining why a particular edge is included or excluded in the learned directed acyclic graph (DAG). This is critical in real-world applications, where no ground-truth DAG exists and every structural decision must be independently justified. We formalize this requirement as decision traceability, requiring every inferred edge to be supported by auditable statistical evidence, Markov Blanket consistency, or explicit domain reasoning. We propose GENESIS, an explainable hybrid CD framework that decomposes graph construction into interpretable decision points. GENESIS first identifies and scores three-node structural motifs, including chains, forks, and colliders, to establish transparent structural priors, then progressively refines the graph by integrating these priors with observational evidence, invoking domain knowledge only when statistical evidence is insufficient. By design, every edge decision is resolved through an auditable source of evidence. Experiments show that GENESIS achieves 100% decision traceability across all settings, establishing explainability as a first-class objective in causal discovery. Despite this additional requirement, GENESIS consistently outperforms purely statistical CD methods on the majority of benchmark datasets across all sample regimes in terms of Structural Hamming Distance (SHD), while achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art LLM-assisted approaches. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Causal Discovery (CD)]] [[Decision Traceability]] [[Structural Motifs]] [[LLM-assisted hybrid approaches]] [[Markov Blanket consistency]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出GENESIS混合框架，首先识别并评分三节点结构模体（链、叉、汇）以建立透明结构先验，随后将先验与观测证据整合；仅在统计证据不足时调用领域知识，确保每条边的推断均有可审计的证据来源。 💬 锐评 该文精准切中LLM辅助因果发现'重性能轻解释'的痛点，将'决策可追溯性'形式化为核心需求极具前瞻性。虽然摘要显示其性能仅与SOTA LLM方法相当，但在真实世界无真值场景下，100%的可解释性价值远超微小的指标提升。需警惕其对三节点模体的依赖可能限制复杂高阶交互的发现能力。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.title: Provable Coordination for LLM Agents via Message Sequence Charts
MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.short_review: 该方法通过引入形式化验证有效解决了LLM智能体系统中难以检测的死锁和结构错位问题，实现了“结构确定、内容不确定”的折中。但其局限性在于MSC的定义本身就是一种强约束，虽然能保证通信拓扑的正确性，却无法保证LLM生成内容的语义有效性，且灵活的动态规划可能削弱形式化证明的严密性，工程落地门槛在于如何设计高质量的MSC规范。

Coordination errors such as deadlocks or type-mismatched messages are often hard to detect through testing. We introduce a domain-specific language for specifying agent coordination based on message sequence charts (MSCs). The language separates message-passing structure from LLM calls, tool calls, and human control points, whose outcomes remain unpredictable. We define the syntax and semantics of the language and present a syntax-directed projection that generates deadlock-free local agent programs from global coordination specifications. We illustrate the approach with a diagnosis consensus protocol and show how coordination properties can be established independently of LLM nondeterminism. We also describe a runtime planning extension in which an LLM dynamically generates a coordination workflow for which the same structural guarantees apply. An open-source Python implementation of our framework is available as ZipperGen. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Message Sequence Charts (MSCs)]] [[Domain-Specific Language (DSL)]] [[Syntax-directed projection]] [[Deadlock-free]] [[Runtime planning]] [[ZipperGen]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出一种基于消息序列图（MSC）的领域特定语言（DSL），通过语法导向投影将全局协调规范编译为无死锁的局部智能体程序，从而将确定性的消息传递结构与不确定性的LLM/工具调用分离。 💬 锐评 该方法通过引入形式化验证有效解决了LLM智能体系统中难以检测的死锁和结构错位问题，实现了“结构确定、内容不确定”的折中。但其局限性在于MSC的定义本身就是一种强约束，虽然能保证通信拓扑的正确性，却无法保证LLM生成内容的语义有效性，且灵活的动态规划可能削弱形式化证明的严密性，工程落地门槛在于如何设计高质量的MSC规范。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.title: Graph-of-Agents: A Graph-based Framework for Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.short_review: GoA 的主要优势在于其结构化的消息传递机制和图表示，有效解决了多 LLM 协作中的选择、通信和整合问题。然而，其性能优势（仅用 3 个智能体优于 6 个）可能依赖于特定任务和基准，且双向消息传递的复杂度较高。此外，模型卡片的质量和覆盖范围可能影响节点采样的效果。
MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.full_note: Graph-of-Agents: A Graph-based Framework for Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Communication_Topology 👤 作者： Sukwon Yun, Jie Peng, Pingzhi Li, Wendong Fan, Jie Chen, James Zou, Guohao Li, Tianlong Chen 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-04-18 21:13:03 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17148v1 🧾 一句话总结： Graph-of-Agents 通过图结构优化多 LLM 协作，以少量高相关智能体实现优于大规模集成的性能。 📄 摘要： With an ever-growing zoo of LLMs and benchmarks, the need to orchestrate multiple models for improved task performance has never been more pressing. While frameworks like Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) attempt to coordinate LLMs, they often fall short in terms of (1) selecting relevant agents, (2) facilitating effective intra-agent communication, and (3) integrating responses efficiently. In this work, we propose Graph-of-Agents (GoA), a new graph-based framework for modeling multi-agent LLM communication. Our approach begins with node sampling, selecting only the most relevant agents by leveraging model cards that summarize each model's domain, task specialization, and other characteristics. Next, we construct edges between the selected agents by evaluating their responses against one another to determine relevance ordering. Directed message passing is then performed from highly relevant agents to less relevant ones to enhance their responses, followed by reverse message passing to refine the original responses of the more relevant agents. Finally, the updated responses are aggregated via graph-based pooling (e.g., max or mean pooling) to produce a single, unified answer. We evaluate GoA on diverse multi-domain benchmarks (MMLU, MMLU-Pro, GPQA) and domain-specific benchmarks (MATH, HumanEval, MedMCQA), with an agent pool of 6 LLMs spanning multiple domains. Surprisingly, GoA achieves superior performance using only 3 selected agents, outperforming recent multi-agent LLM baselines that utilize all 6 agents simultaneously. By adopting a graph structure, GoA offers both scalability and effectiveness through structured message passing-positioning it as a strong candidate for navigating the challenges of the ever-growing LLM zoo. Code is available at: https://github.com/UNITES-Lab/GoA. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Graph-of-Agents]] [[节点采样]] [[边构建]] [[双向消息传递]] [[图池化]] [[模型卡片]] 🔬 核心方法简述 Graph-of-Agents (GoA) 是一种基于图的多智能体 LLM 协作框架。该方法通过节点采样选择最相关的 LLM，构建边以确定智能体间的关系，进行双向消息传递以增强响应，最后通过图池化聚合更新后的响应。关键步骤包括：1) 利用模型卡片选择相关智能体；2) 通过互评构建有向边；3) 双向消息传递（从高相关到低相关，再反向）；4) 图池化聚合结果。 💬 锐评 GoA 的主要优势在于其结构化的消息传递机制和图表示，有效解决了多 LLM 协作中的选择、通信和整合问题。然而，其性能优势（仅用 3 个智能体优于 6 个）可能依赖于特定任务和基准，且双向消息传递的复杂度较高。此外，模型卡片的质量和覆盖范围可能影响节点采样的效果。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.title: Beyond Message Passing: A Semantic View of Agent Communication Protocols
MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.short_review: 该研究完成了Agent通信协议领域首个系统性分层梳理，精准点出了当前协议生态“重传输、句法能力建设，轻语义层能力供给”的核心痛点，但研究仅停留在横断面分析层面，未深入探究语义能力缺位的根因，提出的研究议程缺乏可落地的验证路径，通用场景选型指导对复杂异构部署场景的适配性不足
MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.full_note: Beyond Message Passing: A Semantic View of Agent Communication Protocols 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Communication_Topology 👤 作者： Dun Yuan, Fuyuan Lyu, Ye Yuan, Weixu Zhang, Bowei He, Jiayi Geng, Linfeng Du, Zipeng Sun, Yankai Chen, Changjiang Han, Jikun Kang, Xi Chen, Haolun Wu, Xue Liu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-03-30 00:40:30 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.02369v3 🧾 一句话总结： 本研究通过三层分析框架系统梳理现有Agent通信协议的能力短板，指出现有协议过度聚焦传输与句法能力、语义层支撑缺位的问题，为后续协议设计与语义鲁棒的Agent生态构建提供了清晰的参考框架 📄 摘要： Agent communication protocols are becoming critical infrastructure for large language model (LLM) systems that must use tools, coordinate with other agents, and operate across heterogeneous environments. This work presents a human-inspired perspective on this emerging landscape by organizing agent communication into three layers: communication, syntactic, and semantic. Under this framework, we systematically analyze 18 representative protocols and compare how they support reliable transport, structured interaction, and meaning-level coordination. Our analysis shows a clear imbalance in current protocol design. Most protocols provide increasingly mature support for transport, streaming, schema definition, and lifecycle management, but offer limited protocol-level mechanisms for clarification, context alignment, and verification. As a result, semantic responsibilities are often pushed into prompts, wrappers, or application-specific orchestration logic, creating hidden interoperability and maintenance costs. To make this gap actionable, we further identify major forms of technical debt in today's protocol ecosystem and distill practical guidance for selecting protocols under different deployment settings. We conclude by outlining a research agenda for interoperable, secure, and semantically robust agent ecosystems that move beyond message passing toward shared understanding. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Agent通信三层分析框架]] [[语义级协调]] [[协议级技术债务]] [[消息传递范式]] [[上下文对齐]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出「通信层-句法层-语义层」三层Agent通信分析框架，系统评估18个代表性协议在可靠传输、结构化交互、语义级协调三类核心能力的支撑情况，识别领域技术债务并给出不同部署场景的协议选型指导与研究议程 💬 锐评 该研究完成了Agent通信协议领域首个系统性分层梳理，精准点出了当前协议生态“重传输、句法能力建设，轻语义层能力供给”的核心痛点，但研究仅停留在横断面分析层面，未深入探究语义能力缺位的根因，提出的研究议程缺乏可落地的验证路径，通用场景选型指导对复杂异构部署场景的适配性不足 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。
